updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention Admin Units Support for Copilot & Cowork
updates.summary: DLP policies can now be scoped to Administrative Units for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork, enabling delegated policy management without granting tenant-wide permissions. This supports organizations with regional, departmental, or regulatory boundaries by allowing AU-scoped administrators to manage Copilot DLP independently.

updates.title: 3 Elevation of Privilege Vulnerabilities Patched in Microsoft Office SharePoint
updates.summary: Microsoft Office SharePoint received security patches for three authorization flaws (CVE-2026-102861, CVE-2026-102862, CVE-2026-105720) that could allow authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Admins should apply these updates to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation in their SharePoint environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Guided Diagnostics Experience with Copilot Insights
updates.summary: A new diagnostic tool helps admins understand and troubleshoot DLP policy behavior by showing which policies triggered, evaluation order, and condition details; E5 customers also get Copilot-powered recommendations for policy optimization. This reduces troubleshooting time and improves DLP policy effectiveness across the organization.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope Lifecycle Status Evaluation Control
updates.summary: Adaptive Scopes will now provide explicit control over how recipient and site owner lifecycle states are evaluated during policy targeting, ensuring scope membership stays aligned with organizational needs. This gives admins finer control over who is included or excluded from adaptive scope-based policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Rights Management Connector Certificate-Based Authentication
updates.summary: The Microsoft RMS connector is transitioning from shared-secret to certificate-based authentication, improving security by requiring admins to configure their own Entra app registration and certificate. New PowerShell cmdlets simplify deployment and certificate management across Connector, Exchange, SharePoint, and FCI workloads.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling for Legacy Office File Formats
updates.summary: Server-side auto-labeling now supports legacy Office formats (.doc, .xls, .ppt) in SharePoint and OneDrive, automatically applying sensitivity labels based on policy rules. This closes a gap for organizations with older file repositories and ensures consistent labeling across legacy and modern file types.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Network DLP Scoping for All Websites via Entra GSA Integration
updates.summary: DLP policies integrated with Entra Global Secure Access can now scope protection to all websites or all websites except specific cloud apps, extending coverage beyond the Defender Cloud App Catalog. This allows admins to protect emerging and niche cloud services with network-layer data loss prevention.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Alert Auto-Resolution and Rule-Based Tagging
updates.summary: Admins can now define rules to automatically resolve predictable DLP alerts and tag alerts for routing and categorization, reducing alert fatigue and improving triage efficiency. For example, rules can auto-resolve low-severity alerts to trusted partners or auto-tag legal department alerts for business-process routing.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Apply Default SharePoint Library Labels to Data at Rest
updates.summary: Auto-labeling can now retroactively apply a SharePoint library's default sensitivity label to existing files, automatically closing labeling gaps without requiring manual user action. This ensures consistent, secure-by-default protection across all SharePoint libraries.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Retention Based on Last Accessed for SharePoint and OneDrive Files
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management can now apply retention schedules based on when files were last accessed in SharePoint and OneDrive, enabling more nuanced governance based on file usage patterns. This helps organizations optimize storage and retention costs by targeting truly inactive content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention Policies
updates.summary: Admins can now include file archiving actions within SharePoint retention policies, moving inactive content to low-cost storage while keeping it discoverable and accessible. This extends DLM capabilities beyond keep/delete decisions and improves cost management for long-term data governance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection File Labeler and Viewer for macOS
updates.summary: The Information Protection File Labeler and Viewer applications are now available on macOS, bringing core labeling and viewing capabilities to Mac users (except advanced label-based protection). This extends unified data protection to Apple ecosystem users.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP AI-Powered Device Health Investigation
updates.summary: An AI agent skill has been added to detect and alert on unhealthy DLP policy sync and device configuration issues across Endpoint DLP deployments. This proactively identifies configuration drift and policy synchronization problems that could leave endpoints unprotected.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Barriers Policy Compliance Report
updates.summary: A new Information Barriers compliance report identifies SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that no longer comply after policy changes, helping admins quickly remediate non-compliant content. This improves visibility and compliance tracking for Information Barriers implementations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Network Data Security General Availability with Entra GSA Integration
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Network Data Security is now generally available, integrating with Entra Global Secure Access to enforce DLP policies at the network layer for text, files, and AI interactions. This prevents sensitive data exfiltration to untrusted cloud apps, social media, and generative AI platforms while enabling Insider Risk Management detection.
